newsitem.title: USA: Community Financial to buy Illinois bank.
newsitem.headline: Community Financial to buy Illinois bank.

text.p: Community Financial Corp said Wednesday it signed an agreement to purchase the MidAmerica Bank of St. Clair County for $5.6 million cash.
The bank, located in O'Fallon, Illinois, has total assets of $16 million.

The company said following the acquisition, it expects it will keep MidAmerica as a separate bank subsidiary. Most directors have agreed to continue to serve as directors following the transaction, and all staff members will be retained.
The acquisition is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 1997 and is subject to various conditions.
Following the deal, Community Financial will have consolidated assets of about $230 million.
